title: Instant Software Factories
abstract: arXiv:2610.36254v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Coding agents can quickly build prototypes, but a long tail of fixes, optimizations, tests, and releases separates a prototype from a product. A software factory handles this ongoing work through a repeatable process. We ask whether this work needs dedicated orchestration and how such factories should be judged. Given a tested repository and a coding agent, an instant software factory uses only two coordination inputs, a swarm of cron-job agents with standing objectives and a shared communication board, such as GitHub, where agents coordinate through the traces they leave. We developed a bootstrap prompt designed to set up both inputs from one round of human input, with governance as a separable layer. We distilled it from two manually configured industrial factories, observed for 15 and 17 days, and have not yet evaluated it. translated_abstract: 编码智能体可以快速构建原型，但从原型到产品之间还隔着一条由修复、优化、测试和发布组成的长尾工作。软件工厂通过可重复的流程来处理这些持续性工作。我们探究的问题是：这些工作是否需要专门的编排，以及应该如何评判这类工厂。给定一个经过测试的代码仓库和一个编码智能体，即时软件工厂仅使用两个协调输入：一群具有固定目标的定时任务（cron-job）智能体，以及一个共享的沟通看板（如GitHub），智能体在其中通过各自留下的痕迹进行协调。我们开发了一个引导提示词（bootstrap prompt），旨在仅通过一轮人类输入就能设置好这两个协调输入，并将治理作为可分离的独立层。该提示词是从两个手动配置的工业工厂中提炼而来的，这两个工厂分别被观察了15天和17天，而该提示词本身尚未经过评估。在GitHub协调的CLI工厂中，智能体部署期间每日代码合并（merge）次数增长了15倍，这是一个观察到的关联。
tldr: 该论文提出“即时软件工厂”概念，仅凭一轮人类输入即可通过引导提示词自动配置出定时任务智能体群和共享沟通看板两个协调机制，以可重复流程处理从原型到产品之间的长尾工程工作，并观察到每日代码合并量提升15倍。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the "instant software factory," which, from just one round of human input via a bootstrap prompt, sets up a swarm of cron-job agents with standing objectives and a shared communication board (e.g., GitHub) to automate the long-tail work from prototype to product, with an observed 15x rise in daily merges.
